title: No Smoking Sign - 12V Cigarette Lighter Socket Plug Cover for Car-Truck-Boat
description_markdown: table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; } th, td { border: 1px solid #ddd; padding: 8px; } th { background-color: #f2f2f2; text-align: left; } Product Description Want a polite yet clear way to tell people your vehicle's smoke-free? This lighter safety plug firmly inserts into your vehicle's lighter receptacle to take the place of your unwanted cigarette lighter element, with the added benefit of preventing accidental shocks or burns. It's also pretty handy for capping even a normal power outlet that's missing a cover that you don't want to use or want to keep clean of dust, liquids or debris. They're available in packs of 1 if you're just fixing up your own vehicle, or 20 if you want to keep a whole vehicle fleet clean and smoke-free. Enhances safety - this power outlet/cigarette lighter safety plug is designed to fit receptacles in a variety of vehicle interiors to help prevent unwanted and unsafe access to an electrified outlet Protects interior - provide an easy way to prevent damage to receptacles, and the immediately recognizable red and white imprint alerts drivers and passengers that they are in a smoke-free vehicle Durable construction - designed and manufactured to strict specifications for reliable performance Bulk quantity available - a convenient pack of 20 plugs are available and perfect for fleet use; order Dorman part number 702-199 Product Specifications Attachment Type: Press Fit Color: Black; Red; White Indicator Markings: Yes Knob Outside Diameter: 0.81 in Length: 1.25 in Material: Plastic Package Contents: 1 Plug Package Quantity: 1 Packaging Type: Card Selling Package Quantity UOM: Piece Universal Or Specific Fit: Universal
